name: writeSuccessTail
comment: The tail chain: four segments between two frozen predicates. 0x158e0 is the exit of the suffix hashes loop and 0x15a0c is the epilogue's exit, and both are merged and stay as they are. The three junctions between them -- 0x1596c, 0x159b8, 0x159d8 -- are hand-written boundaries today and are inferred here.
